goal: Wave 3 build: Profile in the cached prefix (Ask and Do); Space memory recall, owner list/delete, erasure; Personal first-run step; Per-call sandbox enforcement report; Egress tier enum and Space egress entitlement in Control; Credential custody ADR for the injecting proxy; Provider data-use label in the model picker; SHA-pinned GitHub Actions NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100 (EP-8-S4), 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14); take your reserved round-B number or the next free at or above 0107; capability-core at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object.

For Do runs adds RunContext.user_profile = 7 (round A/B final: EP-6 takes 8, EP-7 takes 9; 5 and 6 stay reserved for WS08/WS20) filled under the plan_memory skips and placed by execution-core in the Context tier. Adds metric mp_gateway_chat_profile_injected_total and writes verify-personalisation.sh. Register the section in EP-14 S7's label table as user text (round A C6).
slices.remaining: Whole slice: PromptContext profile slot, Ask fetch, RunContext.user_profile=7 on Do, metrics, verify-personalisation script.

slices.title: Space memory recall, owner list/delete, erasure
slices.summary: Space-thread recall returns only scope='space' rows for the thread's Space whose audience_hash equals the thread's current hash and counts the rest as withheld (SearchMemoryResponse.withheld=5); no user/org/thread rows (isolation). ListMemoryRequest gains space_id=4; the Space owner/admin lists and deletes via a Control Space decision; BFF routes /api/v1/spaces/:space_ref/memory resolve the Space server-side; a Space memory tab is added. Space deletion erases scope IN ('space','agent') rows in the same transaction and GDPR user erasure drops the user's sources. No migration (uses S6's).
